narrative: When the old empire's wishing coin split in two, its twelve sworn clans reclaimed the ancestral seals once surrendered to the imperial mint. Now every clan tells a different story of the breaking: betrayal, liberation, accident or prophecy. They contest the seals through champions, hoping to reunite the coin and decide what the next age will become. Every flip is an omen; every Flip Off settles a small feud in that greater struggle. Three echoes of a champion awaken the next form of their clan's legacy. Nobody knows whether the coin grants wishes or merely reveals what each clan is willing to wager.
